mainEntity.name: What is India crypto PR and who is it for?

acceptedAnswer.text: India crypto PR is a dual-track media strategy that places crypto and blockchain founders simultaneously in Indian business and startup press (Inc42, Economic Times, Entrackr) and in global crypto tier-1 outlets (CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, Decrypt). It is for founders who are based in India, raising from Indian capital, or building a product for the Indian market and need credibility in both channels at once. A fractional senior operator runs this directly for $5K–$12K/month.

mainEntity.name: How much does India crypto PR cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A fractional senior operator running a dual-track India campaign costs $5K–$12K per month, which covers both India business press and global crypto outlet pitching. A launch sprint focused on a single announcement, such as a raise or mainnet, runs $15K–$40K over four to eight weeks. Traditional agencies with India desks typically charge $15K–$45K per month because the retainer funds a larger team.

mainEntity.name: Which India outlets can you actually place stories in?

acceptedAnswer.text: India business and startup press: Inc42, Economic Times Tech, Entrackr, YourStory, The Morning Context and Mint (where the angle is strong enough). India crypto-specific: CoinCrunch India and crypto columns in mainstream publications. Global alongside India: CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, The Block, Decrypt, Blockworks and Forbes. Coverage is contingent on a real news hook: a verifiable raise, a product launch, a regulatory milestone or a founder opinion that has something to say.

mainEntity.name: How do you handle India's regulatory environment in pitches?

acceptedAnswer.text: India's regulatory stance on crypto has shifted multiple times since 2018, and editors at Economic Times and Entrackr are alert to stories that could read as unhedged promotion. Every pitch is framed around the legitimate business angle: technology, market traction, user numbers or ecosystem contribution, rather than token price or speculative return. That framing works better for editorial acceptance and is less likely to attract regulator scrutiny.

mainEntity.name: How do I get started with India crypto PR?

acceptedAnswer.text: Send a short project brief through the intent form and you will get a reply within 24 hours with a quick read on your India press footprint and the one angle most likely to work with India business editors right now. Alternatively, book a 30-minute call and we will plot the dual-track approach live, no deck or account-team intro required.
